# tg-mini-app-uikit

> iOS-flavored React UI kit for Telegram Mini Apps: 100+ TK* components, full Bot API 9.6
> platform layer with an injectable browser mock, design tokens, i18n, gestures, a screen
> stack with swipe-back — zero runtime dependencies, React 18/19 peer.
> This file is the compact map for AI agents writing code against the kit.
> The full reference with props and patterns: docs/llms-full.md.

## Setup

- `npm i tg-mini-app-uikit` ; peer deps: react, react-dom (18 or 19).
- Local explorer: `npm run stories` starts Storybook; `npm run check:stories && npm run stories:build` verifies TK* story coverage and static compilation.
- `import "tg-mini-app-uikit/style.css"` once (tokens + utilities, lives in the `tk` CSS layer).
- App entry: `await tkResolveTelegramBridge()` before mount — loads the vendored `telegram-web-app.js` (never from telegram.org at runtime) and classifies the launch (`isRealTelegramBridge`); real client → native chrome, `null` → browser fallbacks.
- Wrap the app: `<TKTelegramProvider haptics><TKProvider theme="dark" telegram accent="#3390ec">…`
- Shell: `TKAppShell` caps the app column at the stable viewport (no iOS keyboard two-jump); `TKApp` bundles shell + host background, bare-`TKProvider` apps call `useTKHostBackground(theme)` to paint html/body. `TKViewportForensics` = on-device debug overlay behind `?kbdebug=1`.
  - `TKProvider` renders the `.tk` root: anchors overlays/toasts, owns the CSS variables.
  - `telegram` flag inherits the live `--tg-theme-*` palette; `preset="material"` flattens radii.
  - `TKTelegramProvider webApp={mock}` injects a WebApp implementation (tests, browsers).
- Localization: `<TKLocaleProvider locale={ruLocale}>` (en default, `ru` shipped, any `Partial<TKLocale>`).

## Component map (all exports start with TK)

- Actions: TKButton (polymorphic `as="a" href`, `loading`), TKIconButton (size sm|md|lg, `badge`), TKMainButton (promise-driven idle→loading→success), TKInlineButtons, TKTappable, TKSpinner.
- Forms: TKInput (password toggle, maxLength counter, prefix/suffix), TKTextarea, TKSelect (searchable, option groups), TKMultiselect (selectAll), TKChipsInput, TKMaskedInput (`#`-masks) / TKPhoneInput / TKTimeInput, TKCalendar + TKDateInput (single/range, min/max, disabledDates, Intl), TKPinInput (keypad + biometrics key), TKOTP, TKFileInput (dropZone, progress, preview), TKCheckbox (indeterminate), TKRadioGroup, TKSwitch, TKSlider (range + marks), TKStepper (hold-to-repeat, editable), TKRating (readonly, allowHalf), TKSearch, TKSelectable, TKFormField (TKFormInput aliases TKInput), TKNativeField, TKChip/TKChipGroup.
- Display: TKText/TKTitle/TKCaption, TKBadge, TKDot, TKCounter (max → "99+"), TKAvatar (status dot) / TKAvatarStack, TKImage (srcSet, blur-up placeholderSrc) / TKImg, TKSpoiler, TKBlockquote, TKGallery (scroll-snap carousel), TKIcon (77 names in TK_ICON_NAMES), TKEllipsis (visual clamp + animated show-more, SR reads full text), TKVisuallyHidden.
- Lists: TKListGroup, TKCell (polymorphic, toggle/badge/chevron), TKAccordion (lazy), TKInfiniteList, TKVirtualList (fixed row height), TKSwipeCell (leading/trailing actions, full swipe).
- Navigation: TKNavStack/TKNavPanel/useNav (push/pop/replace/popTo, swipe-back edge|anywhere, state preserved), TKHeader (large, collapsing, back="auto" dedups the native Back button), TKTabbar, TKTabView (keep-mounted bottom-tab shell, tabbar auto-hides under keyboard), TKKeepMountTabs/TKKeepMountTab + useTabActive, TKSegmented, TKCategoryTabs, TKSteps, TKPageDots.
- Overlays: TKSheet (snapPoints, sheetRef close/snapTo, dismissible, swipe-to-close, modal={false} passive mode), TKDialog (onConfirm on Enter), TKActionSheet, TKPopper (arrow, autoFlip), TKTooltip, TKToastProvider/useTKToast (position top|bottom, action), TKImageViewer (shared-element open, pinch-zoom, swipe-down close), TKNoticeBar (tone strip, marquee), TKFrame. Modal overlays suppress the native Main/Secondary buttons while open (opt out per overlay: nativeButtons="keep").
- Layout: TKApp (bootstrap: shell + host background), TKAppShell (stable-viewport-capped column), TKPage (scroll context for collapsing headers), TKSafeArea, TKBottomBar, TKViewportForensics (?kbdebug=1 overlay).
- Patterns: TKMessages/TKMessageBubble/TKWriteBar (chat), TKOnboardingTooltip (coach marks + storage adapter), TKConfetti (reduced-motion safe), TKPullToRefresh, TKSlotPicker, TKPaymentSummary, TKXPHeader, TKLeaderboard, TKWalletConnectButton/TKWalletStatusCell, TKEmptyState, TKAsyncState/AsyncBoundary (one of loading/error/empty), skeletons (TKSkeleton, TKSkeletonText, TKSkeletonCard, TKSkeletonList, TKSkeletonTable), TKProgress/TKRing/TKBars/TKTimeline, cards (TKCard, TKCardCell, TKCardChip, TKProductCardA, TKProductCardB, TKBannerCard, TKBookingCard, TKStatTile).

## Platform hooks (Bot API 9.6, all degrade to no-ops outside Telegram)

useWebApp, useTelegramTheme, useViewport, useSafeArea, useMainButton/useSecondaryButton,
useBackButton + useBackIntercept/useBackDispatcher (LIFO back queue: open sheets intercept
before nav stacks), useSettingsButton, useHaptics + useOptionalHaptics (provider-gated),
useTelegramPopup, useCloudStorage/useDeviceStorage/useSecureStorage, useInitData, useInvoice,
useShare, useClipboard, useQrScanner, useBiometrics, useLocation, useMotionSensors,
useFullscreen, useOrientationLock, useHomeScreen, useEmojiStatus, useContactRequest,
useWriteAccess, useChatRequest, useDownloadFile, useDataTransport, useTelegramLinks,
useTelegramColors, useClosingConfirmation, useActivity, useKeyboard (visualViewport +
host-managed-keyboard modes), useHideKeyboard, useTelegramEvent, useTelegramEnvironment
(the "am I really inside Telegram?" primitive), useVerticalSwipes (swipe-to-minimize),
useSuppressNativeButtons/useNativeButtonsSuppressed (overlay arbitration),
useBackButtonWanted (native Back already claimed), useTKHostBackground (paint html/body).

UIKit-side hooks: useHasNativeChrome (native chrome vs in-DOM fallbacks), useReducedMotion,
useLongPress, useOptionalNav, useTKTheme, useTKLocale, useTKBusyAnnounce.

## Conventions agents must follow

- Controlled/uncontrolled: every stateful component takes `value`/`defaultValue` + `onChange`.
- `testId` prop → `data-testid` on every component root.
- Options are `TKOption[]`: plain strings or `{ value, label?, icon?, disabled? }`; TKSelect also accepts `{ label, options }` groups.
- Refs: forwardRef everywhere meaningful; inputs forward to the native `<input>` (react-hook-form ready).
- Strings: never hardcode user-facing text in kit overrides — pass props or extend the locale.
- Animations: transform/opacity only; respect tokens (`--tk-ms`, reduced-motion collapses them).
- Anti-patterns: do not wrap TKSheet in your own portal (it anchors to the TKProvider root); do not use number sizes for TKIconButton (deprecated); do not reimplement back handling — use useBackIntercept.

## Testing

- Test support ships `createMockTelegram()` from the `@tg-mini-app/telegram/testing` subpath — a full
  in-browser WebApp mock (buttons, invoices, storages, sensors, biometrics) injectable via
  `TKTelegramProvider webApp=`. It is `sideEffects:false` and dev-only, so it tree-shakes out of production builds.
